input.question: How many people lived in pre-columbus America?
input.ground_truth: Unfortunately, any answer to this question will be highly speculative (not necessarily unsound, but perhaps not sufficiently absolute for the standards of this subreddit). Many indigenous records which might have included population figures were destroyed, or never existed. Archeological evidence can suggest the population of major centers (generally drawing upon accepted cultural evidence for the size of a household in a particular social class, among similar demographic factors), but any further conclusions, especially on the scale of Pre-Columbian America, would be an extrapolation.
